title: REDaCT: Collapse-Free Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12769v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unlearning in large reasoning models (LRMs) requires removing forget-set information from both the reasoning trace and the final answer. Existing approaches achieve this objective at the cost of reasoning collapse, where the model fails to produce a coherent chain-of-thought (CoT) and does not properly terminate its reasoning process. To address this challenge, we propose REDaCT (REgenerate via Detection and Corrective Tuning), an inference-time unlearning framework for LRMs. REDaCT consists of two key components: (1) a binary leak detector that identifies sentences in the reasoning trace that leak forget-set information, and (2) an embedding optimization module that learns a corrective embedding offline, such that when injected at the first detected leak during inference, it guides subsequent reasoning towards sentences that do not leak forget-set information. Experimental results show that REDaCT completely avoids reasoning collapse,

translated_title: REDaCT：大型推理模型中的无坍塌遗忘学习
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型（LRM）中的遗忘学习要求同时从推理轨迹和最终答案中移除遗忘集信息。现有方法在实现这一目标时以推理坍塌为代价，即模型无法生成连贯的思维链（CoT），也无法正确终止其推理过程。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了REDaCT（通过检测与纠错微调实现再生成），一种面向大型推理模型的推理时遗忘学习框架。REDaCT包含两个关键组件：（1）一个二元泄漏检测器，用于识别推理轨迹中泄露遗忘集信息的句子；（2）一个嵌入优化模块，离线学习一个纠错嵌入向量，在推理过程中首次检测到泄漏时将其注入，从而引导后续推理生成不泄露遗忘集信息的句子。实验结果表明，REDaCT完全避免了推理坍塌。
tldr: REDaCT是一种面向大型推理模型的推理时遗忘学习框架，通过泄漏检测器与纠错嵌入注入机制，在不引发推理坍塌的前提下从思维链和最终答案中移除遗忘集信息。
en_tdlr: REDaCT is an inference-time unlearning framework for large reasoning models that removes forget-set information from both chain-of-thought and answers without causing reasoning collapse, by combining a leak detector with corrective embedding injection.
